`events` has a \reset\" row with a value of 5. frm_lincmt() reads a reset to ZERO, which is NONMEM's and rxode2's EVID = 3, as \"forget every dose before this time\", and that needs no state. A reset to a non-zero level sets the peripheral compartments as well. Use frm_ode()"

`events` infuses into the depot of group '1'. That is zero-order absorption, and frm_lincmt() does not fit it: the three-node convolution it needs cannot be written without dividing by a difference of rate constants. An infusion into the CENTRAL compartment is supported. Use frm_ode()

`events` doses compartment 3 of group '1', which is a peripheral compartment. frm_lincmt() doses the depot or the central compartment only: a peripheral compartment has no route of administration, and its impulse response is the one piece of the closed form that has no cancellation-free spelling. `tv` is not available in frm_lincmt(). A dynamics input that changes with time makes the system time-varying, and the closed form is a superposition over the WHOLE history of the group, so a rate constant that changed part way through it would be applied to doses given before the change. Use frm_ode

group '1' has an infusion running at time 4, where the schedule restarts (a \reset\" row, or a steady-state row). frm_lincmt() drops every dose before a restart, so an infusion that spans one would lose the part still to be delivered. Split the infusion at the restart, or use frm_ode()"

every element of `parms` must be named. frm_lincmt() reads its parameters by name, not by position, because which ones a model needs depends on `ncmt` and `depot`. The names are: ke, V, ka, k12, k21, k13, k31 (rate constants), or CL, V, ka, Q2, V2, Q3, V3 (clearances)
`parms` is missing V. A 1-compartment model with a depot needs ke, V, ka
`parms` has k12, which a 1-compartment model with a depot does not use. It needs exactly ke, V, ka. Raise `ncmt`, or set depot = TRUE, or drop the parameter
`parms` mixes the two parameterizations: ke are rate constants and CL are clearances and volumes. Write one or the other; a mixed table has no reading that is not a guess
`ncmt` must be 1, 2 or 3: it is how many compartments the disposition model has, not counting the depot
`output` is \depot\" but `depot` is FALSE, so there is no depot compartment to read"

`output` names 12 things. frm_lincmt() returns ONE column: \conc\", \"central\" or \"depot\". frm_ode()'s per-row `output`, which reads a different state on each row over one shared solve, is not available here; call frm_lincmt() once per compartment and combine the results in the nonlinear body"
`n_ss` must be Inf, or one whole number at least 1: it is how many dosing cycles a steady-state record carries
`event_scale` was given but `events` was not; there is nothing to scale
group '1' has an observation time (1) before t0 (3); frm_lincmt() runs forward from t0
